title: Remember Rama
line: For steadiness, integrity and comfort in hard times.
intro: Rama is the one who keeps his word and does what is right even when it costs him. His name alone is said to be enough: “Rama nama” has carried people through every kind of difficulty.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Sit comfortably, with your back upright and soft. Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it settles. Never strain.

steps.title: He who removes misfortune
steps.text: A verse from the Rama Raksha Stotram: I bow again and again to Rama, who removes misfortune.

steps.title: His name
steps.text: Repeat the verse, or only “Rama”, as many times as feels true.

steps.title: Your word
steps.prompt: Where do I need to keep my word, or stand by what is right?

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Read the closing prayer once, slowly. Then sit for one more breath before you return to your day.

after: Ram Navami is his day of birth.
